alfred.description: Use one or several Claude.ai subscription seats as an Alfred LLM provider — no API key, no per-token billing. Drives Claude Code headlessly via the official Agent SDK, switches seats automatically on usage limits, shows per-seat usage on the Claude accounts page, and lets agents delegate coding tasks to full Claude Code sessions (claude_code_run).

tools.displayName: Claude Code - run a coding session

chatMode.label: Chat mode
chatMode.description: cli = a conversation on this provider runs in Claude Code's own agent loop (native tools, sub-agents, compaction, a persistent session per conversation), with Alfred's persona appended and Alfred's tools over MCP. completion = the older text-only path where Alfred runs the tool loop. Needs a plugin reload.

chatPermissionMode.label: Default permission mode
chatPermissionMode.description: Permission mode of a conversation that has not chosen one. bypassPermissions = no checks (Alfred adds no rules); auto = Claude's classifier decides; acceptEdits = file edits allowed, anything else needing approval is refused; plan = read-only.

chatPermissionModeMax.label: Permission mode ceiling
chatPermissionModeMax.description: Most permissive mode any conversation may run in.

autoSwitchMidTurn.label: Switch seat mid-turn
autoSwitchMidTurn.description: When a seat hits its usage limit in the middle of a turn, continue the same session on the next seat instead of stopping.

sharedSessionStore.label: Share sessions across seats
sharedSessionStore.description: Link every seat's projects/, file-history/, tasks/ and todos/ to the default login's (~/.claude) with directory junctions, so any seat can resume any session (and terminal sessions become resumable). Existing seat dirs are backed up and merged first. Needs a plugin reload.

oauthToken.label: Setup token for the default account (legacy, optional)
oauthToken.description: Long-lived token from `claude setup-token`, used by the 'Default login' account only when it has no interactive login. Prefer the Claude accounts page: it manages one login or token per seat.

models.label: Models
models.description: Comma-separated list of models to expose in the picker. Use aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) to always track the latest of each family, or pin a full id (e.g. claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Optional display name after a pipe: 'opus|Claude Opus'.

contextWindow.label: Context window
contextWindow.description: Context window (tokens) reported for every exposed model. Used by the UI for the context gauge.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the first output of a turn on one account before giving up. The Claude Code SDK has no timeout of its own, so without this a wedged CLI (missing binary, interactive login it cannot show) blocks the shared plugin worker forever. Disarmed as soon as the model starts producing, so long answers are never cut short.

maxConcurrentRequests.label: Max concurrent requests
maxConcurrentRequests.description: How many requests Alfred may run on this provider at once. 0 = unlimited (every sub-agent of a delegate_parallel call starts at once). Each request is its own CLI process on a seat. Needs a plugin reload.

maxParallelTasks.label: Max sub-agents per parallel call
maxParallelTasks.description: How many sub-agents one delegate_parallel call may fan out to. 0 = unlimited. Needs a plugin reload.

pathToClaude.label: Path to claude executable (optional)
pathToClaude.description: Absolute path to the `claude` CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect an installed native CLI (needed for live usage and effort control), falling back to the one bundled with the Agent SDK.

sessionPermissionMode.label: Session permission mode
sessionPermissionMode.description: Most permissive mode a delegated Claude Code session may run in (claude_code_run). plan = read-only; acceptEdits = edit files and run the allowed tools without asking; bypassPermissions = no permission checks at all (any tool, any command). A call can ask for less, never more.

sessionAllowedTools.label: Session allowed tools
sessionAllowedTools.description: Comma-separated Claude Code tools a session may use without asking (Bash(npm test:*) style rules work too). Anything else is refused. Empty = the default development set.
sessionAllowedTools.default: Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Glob, Grep, LS, Bash, BashOutput, KillBash, KillShell, TodoWrite, Task, WebFetch, WebSearch

sessionModel.label: Session default model
sessionModel.description: Model for claude_code_run when the call names none. Empty = the first model of the catalog.

sessionTimeoutMs.label: Session timeout (ms)
sessionTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget of one Claude Code session; it is stopped after this. 0 = none (the session runs until Claude is done or is cancelled). Needs a plugin reload.

sessionMaxTurns.label: Session max turns
sessionMaxTurns.description: Default turn cap of one session (a call may set its own maxTurns). 0 = no cap.
